title: Rent payment received
description: Confirm rent was received on WhatsApp with amount, month and receipt number. Utility template for property managers and landlords.
notes: Add a receipt ID and the period covered. Tenants keep these messages as proof of payment.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we received your rent payment of *{{amount}}* for {{month}} on {{date}}. Receipt: {{receipt_id}}. Thank you!
